# **Book Launch Memo & Key Details**

### **Context:**

18 months ago we did the launch that broke the internet. We still ride this goodwill today. But, it’s time to do another one and re-anchor ourselves as top in the business space.

### **Confirmed Date:** 9:00AM August 16th, 2025\. 

### **Objective(s):**

Each book is a meta concept. Offers was an offer so good you’d feel stupid saying no. Leads was a crazy advertising campaign and an offer so good you’d feel stupid saying no. And this launch uses the skills from offers, leads, and adds in monetization.

It would be iconic to continue the $100M series with a $100M Money Models launch, and break two Guinness World Records;

1. **Set a new Guinness World Record** for the **most books sold in 24 hours by a single author** – targeting over **1.5 million units** on Day 1 of release**.**  
2. **Most viewers of a book launch live stream on YouTube**, with a current record of 151,161 concurrent viewers. hosted live in conjunction with the book launch.

Post launch, we kick off aggressive PR about the record breaking launch to reinforce and memorialize the brand moment.

### **Project Resources:**

1. **Project Owner (Name, Contract)**  
   **Key Responsibilities**: Oversee the entire project, manage timelines, coordinate between teams (tech, affiliates, ads, media, shipping, PR), and ensure all phases are executed on time to facilitate a record breaking launch.   
2. **Sales Support Lead (Name, Contract)**  
   **Key Responsibilities**: Facilitate and oversee the day of launch sales and ensure adequate staffing to handle and maximize sales volume. Source and stand up surge sales support staff of 300 reps at peak volume and 125+ during no peak sales hours.   
3. **eCommerce StoreOwner (Name)**  
   **Key Responsibilities**: Oversee all technical aspects of the eCommerce Storestore setup, integration with ShipBob, Affirm, and payment gateways. Load testing for traffic surges, and optimized checkout experience.   
4. **Media Manager (Name)**  
   **Key Responsibilities**: Plan, create, and schedule organic social content, BTS videos, & YouTube announcements leading up to the launch. Oversee the facilitation of YT live set up and ensure accuracy and time for day of Launch and work with the Video team to complete Launch venue set up. Facilitate 1,000+ Ad creative edits and light hero ads.   
5. **Marketing Manager (Name)**  
     
   **Key Responsibilities:** Ensure all email, SMS, Direct Mail & VM campaigns are launched on time, with correct links, and copy. Complete all landing pages and ensure they are tested and taken live on set due dates. Oversee paid traffic throughout the launch and ensure effective campaigns driving 1,000,000m registrations. Own and execute Affiliate launch.   
6. **Book Logistics Manager (Name)**  
   **Key Responsibilities:** Manage inventory, coordinate with ShipBob for 3PL prep, ensure on-time delivery with editors and printers, handle shipping logistics for books, playbooks and all printed material, and facilitate Amazon book launch.   
7. **Customer Support Lead (Name)**  
   **Key Responsibilities**: Hire & manage a team of surge support reps for the checkout hotline, handle inquiries, resolve issues, and provide post-purchase assistance. Implement a self service help desk with chat support and ticketing to facilitate quick resolution times for customers and triages to reps as needed.

10. **Tech Infrastructure \-(Name, Name)**  
    **Key Responsibilities**: Complete load testing for all customer entry points on funnels, offer pages and YT link to ensure nothing breaks. Ensure back up power and wifi is set up for launch day. Email and SMS deliverability strategy is compliant and set up for deliverability success and reputation management. 

### **Ad Spend:** 

We plan to spend $3M in advertising across Meta, YT, TikTok, and LinkedIn over the course of 5 weeks leading up to launch. We will ramp up spending to $250,000/per day. . 

### **Ad Overview**

* We will be using **2 companies** to run paid ads.  
  * **Vendor** \- who ran all the traffic for the last book launch.   
    * They will get 80% of advertising budget  
  * **Vendor** \- Current media buying team.   
    * They will get 20% of the advertising budget  
  * If one is out performing the other we will reallocate the ad budget accordingly   
  * Both teams are synced and meet weekly to align on strategy.  
* We have increased daily spend limits in multiple ad accounts and will continue to request this leading up to the launch.   
* We have 3 business managers set up as back up redundancies.

### **How the launch will work:**

The launch will go through preparation, email kick off to our list (6 weeks out), Affiliate Kickoff to our $100M leads Affiliate list (6 weeks out), announcement (4 weeks out), the countdown, the live launch, a replay/cart close mini event the next morning, announcement of the total sales, making it available on amazon etc, and kick off of PR campaign. 

### **Venue: Company Headquarters**

We will be building an inhouse Virtual event space in Alex's studio. We have ordered an LED wall that will be set up and configured for the live. We have contracted Vendor studio set up team to help with LED wall build as well as the onsite AV production of the event. 

The virtual live stream will be hosted on three different links on two different platforms

1. **YT Live Non VIP.** Comment will be enabled to enhance the viewer experience. We will have light moderators in the chat.   
2. **VIP YT Live.** Comments will be enabled and this will be monitored by Alex to pull VIP questions for the mystery guest speakers. This will also be the chat shown on the screen.   
3. Zoom. So that we can mimic a crowded group behind Alex, we’ll invite L2 and L3 people to the zoom link. A manageable number of people we know are “friendlys” and can account for some fall off to showcase the number of faces we want live on the screen. 

**LED Wall / Studio Setup ≈ Timeline**

1. **Vendor** will receive the wall in PHX on {Date}  
2. **Vendor** will load into their warehouse and inspect the product and then load our wall, the ground support and processors into a truck and drive up on {Date}  
3. **Vendor** will load the wall into our studio and assemble it on {Date}

## **Phase III: The Pitch**

We will email and text the YT live link. Alex will welcome everyone and explain how the $100M story is 5 years in the making. He’ll make the pitch for “two types of people” like last year: newbies & entrepreneurs. He’ll do the same stack then free offer, then ascend them back up for the paid offer, emphasizing that if they haven’t gotten that much value from my other content, not to buy.

Free Offer: Everyone who attends will get a show up bonus of the lost chapters. 

On top of that, everyone who attends will get the audiobook and the course free and a 3 month free trial of Skool.

(Implied) Offer: They can buy a book. If someone chooses to buy one book, he'll ask them to upgrade to 15 books and receive the ACQ Closer Handbook and ACQ Advertising Handbook. 

Paid Offer: Alex will offer them the chance to buy 200 books for $5998.00. With this purchase they’ll get: “a year of Hormozi” 12 physical playbooks, 1 half day virtual workshop event, and access to an ACQ AI to accompany. The shipment will be 1 book \+ binder \+ 12 playbooks up front with a book redemption code that has 199 uses.  

The ACQ AI will be built with the following information:

* Money Models Book Leads Book, Offers Book, All 12 Playbooks, Anonymized L3 Notes, ACQ Closer Handbook, ACQ Advertising Handbook

This is given to all 200 book buyers to accompany the 12 playbooks. 

The book redemption code will be free, but anyone using a coupon will have to cover shipping \+ applicable taxes. 

CTA: We will pin comment on zoom with the link to the eCommerce Storestore (for the 200 or so people on zoom) and we will pin the comment on the YT live with the link AND MOST IMPORTANTLY we will have the eCommerce Store button appear ON YT SCREEN LIVE.

Urgency: Cart closes on Tuesday 8/19 at 12:00am PT and this offer will no longer exist. 

Buying Incentive: Anyone who buys the 200 book offer while the live stream is LIVE will get the Launch Collateral Blackbook. Which is all the resources that went into making the launch happen.

## **Phase V: Sales Facilitation**

To accommodate this much volume in such a short window, we will rely on robust tech and surge support. We will make sure that we are good to go by checking in with the CEOs of each platform \- and \- have back up internet ready \+ a generator.

On the people side, we will add in a phone number on the check out page if someone has a problem checking out. 

## **Phase VI:Cart Close**

Cart Close: We will send emails and SMS counting down to the final cart close on 8/19 at 12:00am PST.

Amazon & Other Platforms: After the cart closes, we will make the other versions live on amazon. 

Bundles: After the launch and cart close Hormozi 3-pack goes live on the site. This is a 3 pack of all 3 books.

## **Phase VII: Delivery**

The books will be sent by 3PL, our third party logistics company. We utilize 3 of their warehouses for centralized shipping. These are the potential delivery scenarios:

If someone pre-ordered the book: this shipment will go out first. If they order something else, it will come separately.

If someone orders just one book at the event: it works like normal.

If someone orders 15 books: they will get one book and a discount code for 15 redemptions emailed to them plus a physical copy of ACQ Closer and ACQ Advertising Handbook mailed to them. 

If someone orders 200 books: If someone orders 200 books, they will get one physical book \+ a discount code for 199 redemptions \+ binder \+ 12 playbooks inside. Their checkout page will ask them if they are business owners to prequalify leads. 

## **Phase VIII: Brand Maximization Through PR**

We advertise the launch and event. We have PR firms ready to go prior. We would love to see a bunch of major outlets publishing how some entrepreneurs or social media gurus broke Prince Harry’s single day record. And that we did it by giving everything away.

We make sure we focus on the total books sold, not the amount of money made. And how Influencers are the new age celebrities.
